# Nested single-member unions pass their attributes to the leaves; deeper
# unions' attributes become inferred.
builder
prim i integer
prim b bool
str s unrestricted
union inner i n=Inner desc=inner-docs
union mid inner,b in=Mid
union outer mid,s n=Outer
prim nul null
union other nul,i in=Other
cls x u:outer n=X
cls y u:other n=Y
top X x
top Y y
finish printonrewrite
print
unify 8,9 debug
print
gc
print
